verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform, and a cloud console could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on usage, cost or workloads, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no built-in feature that analyzes the user's data and returns AI insights or suggestions. Preinstalled JupyterLab and Lambda Stack are only developer building blocks, and the community-built MCP server is an unofficial third-party tool, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
